hero.title: Our fun quizzes for couples
hero.description: Light-hearted quizzes that don't measure anything serious: what dog you two should get, what kind of house, and seasonal quizzes for Halloween or Christmas. You each answer separately, then compare.

halloween.intro: Five quizzes for a Halloween night as a couple: a killer portrait, a survival timer, a possession risk, a supervillain portrait and the villain duo you form. It's all for fun, and each one takes five minutes.

noel.intro: The Christmas quizzes arrive before the holidays: which of you is on the nice list, and a few other surprises.

section1.title: What these quizzes are for
section1.p1: The quizzes on this page are nothing like our couple tests. They don't measure anything serious and they don't give your relationship a score. They're games: what dog would suit you as a couple, what kind of house you'd be happy in, or which of you would die first in a horror movie.
section1.p2: They work because you each answer separately. Finding out your other half wants a husky when you had a dachshund in mind, or a fixer-upper when you were dreaming of a city apartment, keeps a good part of the evening busy!
section1.p3: The quizzes about your future together are here all year round. The seasonal ones (Halloween for now, Christmas soon) move to the top of the page when their time comes, and stay playable the rest of the year.

section2.title: And after these quizzes?
section2.p1: Once you've been through them all, the games to play as a couple all year round take over: the “would you rather” dilemmas, truth or dare, the board game, and a dozen others. And for those who want a real answer about their relationship, there's a way to compare your answers on what matters.

section3.title: How to play
section3.p1: All these quizzes play the same way. Together, the first one answers the whole series, passes the phone, and the second one answers in turn without seeing the first one's answers. Solo, you answer and discover your result.
section3.p2: For the quizzes about your future together, the couple gets a single result, the one that fits your two sets of answers best, and the list of questions where you don't agree. For the seasonal quizzes, each of you gets your own, and a remote mode lets you each play on your own phone.
section3.p3: No account to create, nothing to install, and nothing is saved: the answers stay on your phones.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes, all of them, with no sign-up and no app to install. They're played in your phone's browser.
faq.q2: Do you have to be two?
faq.a2: Not necessarily. Almost all of them can be played solo or as a couple, and only the supervillain duo quiz needs two players, since it composes a duo. But they're designed to be taken together: comparing your answers is the fun part.
faq.q3: What happens to the quizzes once the season is over?
faq.a3: They stay on this page, a bit further down, and at their own address. Nothing gets deleted: a Halloween quiz in the middle of March is fine too.
faq.q4: When do the Christmas quizzes arrive?
faq.a4: Before the holidays. On the programme: which of you is on the nice list, and a few other surprises.
faq.a5: Yes for the seasonal quizzes: one person creates the game, the other joins with the code, and you each answer on your own phone. The quizzes about your future together are played on a single phone that you pass to each other.
